gloss: reading through completely; finishing a book

definitions.gloss: reading through completely; finishing reading a book or text
definitions.explanation: The act of reading a book or text all the way through to the end, often implying a sense of accomplishment, especially with lengthy or challenging material.

examples.japanese: ⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧{完読|かんどく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧{本|ほん}だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{完読|かんどく}⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: It was a difficult book, but I managed to read it through.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{二冊|にさつ}{完読|かんどく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ことだ。
examples.english: My goal this year is to finish two books a month.

notes:
A compound of {完|かん} (complete) and {読|どく} (reading). Emphasizes the act of reading something all the way through to the end, especially when the text is long or challenging. Often carries a sense of accomplishment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {完読|かんどく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to read through completely
- {完読|かんどく}⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: to be able to finish reading
- ⟦{一気|いっき}→一気：08891_ikki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{完読|かんどく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to read through in one sitting
- {完読|かんどく}⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧: completion rate (for reading)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {読了|どくりょう}: finishing a book — very similar in meaning; slightly more formal
- ⟦{読破|どくは}→読破：19606_dokuha⟧: reading through (a difficult or long work) — implies overcoming a challenge
- ⟦{通読|つうどく}→通読：19800_tsuudoku⟧: reading through from start to finish — neutral; doesn't imply difficulty
